subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw keep automatic bare-text source replies as the default for direct/group/channel chats, or move those channel sessions toward message-tool-only or final-only delivery with an upgrade path?
rationale: The source-visible leak is a real bug, but the durable fix changes channel delivery defaults and can intentionally break users who rely on automatic bare assistant replies.

options.title: Add a compatibility path
options.body: Preserve shipped automatic reply behavior by default while adding a documented opt-in final-only/message-tool-only policy plus targeted leak suppression and migration guidance.

options.title: Make explicit delivery default
options.body: Switch channel/source chats toward message-tool-only or final-only by default and accept the compatibility cost as the safer product boundary.

options.title: Land only narrow mitigations
options.body: Land PR-level mitigations such as verbose-off suppression and final-tag enforcement, while leaving the larger delivery default decision open.

recommendation.title: Add a compatibility path
recommendation.body: Preserve shipped automatic reply behavior by default while adding a documented opt-in final-only/message-tool-only policy plus targeted leak suppression and migration guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on source-reply delivery defaults and cron delivery helpers, which are the policy-sensitive surfaces in this issue.
